scope: synthetic development of a joint source-acquisition/compiler candidate; not a novelty clearance
state_family: B is any subset of public D; G union D is a DAG; additions persist and only named base edges can fail
producer_inputs: authorized budgeted singleton source membership API
old_promise: R is the exact conditional-cut old encoding of the same frozen source B
old_fiber: B = R union U, where U is any subset of L_R = {e in D minus R: restricted_cut(G union R,e,old_actions) > old_budget}
constructor: Maintain known-present P, initially R. Query a currently behavior-changing authorized unknown e, as certified by restricted cut under the new contract. A positive answer enlarges P and can make other unknown edges redundant. Stop when all unknowns are redundant; compile_multi(P) is then exact for every compatible source. Otherwise permission/budget exhaustion returns UNRESOLVED.
static_comparator: Query every candidate certified relevant relative to initial R, without removing newly redundant candidates after positive answers. Compile with the same compile_multi helper; conservative refusal is allowed. This is a transparent ablation, not the strongest known algorithm.
worlds: all subsets of D; constructors never receive the world bank
verifier: Bitset native closure over every legal failure set and every source subset, after construction. Independently check old fibers, successful class uniformity, actual decode, least retained subsets and residual updates; adaptive unresolved branches must have genuinely different compatible behaviors.
costs: Membership calls, cut requests/misses, compilation, source-backed initialization, shared metadata, stored representation and verifier work are separate. Fewer membership calls are not a total runtime/cost superiority claim.
freeze: All fixtures, orders, budgets and permissions fixed before first execution. No output-driven selection or modification. No independent natural evidence or T2/T5 promotion.
runtime_cost_amendment: After the initial warm-cache development run, clear inherited cut memoization before each constructor invocation so initial source-backed/verifier work cannot subsidize producer costs. No fixture, order, permission, budget or scientific constructor choice changed. Compare the full case-ledger SHA before and after; record both script hashes in the report. This is an execution-cost correction, not new independent confirmation.
